features: HD Stereo Sound Quality: Portronics Dash 4 portable wireless speaker ensures HD stereo sound quality with a powerful 50 Watt speaker. With three distinct modes – bass, normal, and treble – experience crystal clear audio, deep bass, and versatile sound customization perfect for even a home theatre.

Wireless Karaoke Mic: Elevate your gatherings with our portable party speaker's wireless mic, featuring two sound modes for karaoke and speech. Enjoy endless entertainment with the rechargeable mic (via Type C cable), ensuring seamless karaoke nights, presentations, interviews, and more.

Versatile Connectivity: Your all-in-one karaoke solution, offering seamless Bluetooth 5.3 pairing, USB Flash Drive and AUX-In options, a dedicated port for wired mic, headphone output, in-built FM radio, and a convenient Type-C port for easy charging. Enjoy your favorite tunes in multiple ways.

6 RGB Lighting Modes: This bluetooth speaker with bass has colorful RGB lights with 360 degree display spectrum. It also has 6 lighting modes to choose from, to create the perfect ambiance with music and lights for any occasion be it an enjoyable party or a relaxed evening.

Bass Boost Technology: Experience powerful, room-filling sound with the Dash 4 portable wireless speaker featuring the latest bass boost technology, delivering deep and resonant low frequencies for an unparalleled audio experience, making it the perfect audio system.

Long Battery Life with Fast Charging: Enjoy uninterrupted music and karaoke sessions with our speakers for home. Powered by an 4000mAh battery, it offers an impressive 6 hours of playtime. Plus, with the included fast-charging Type C cable, keep the party going by easily recharging the speaker.

Compact and Durable Design: The bluetooth speaker with mic, comes in a premium design and is rated IPX5 water-resistant. Accompanied by a sturdy leather handle, it ensures both style and durability for a worry-free and enjoyable experience.
